text: The Nifty 50 closes about 2.5% higher after the U.S. signals an overall tariff reduction to roughly 18% on Indian exports and India commits to eliminating tariffs/non-tariff barriers on U.S. goods. The rupee strengthens about 1% to ~90.26 per dollar after a year of persistent foreign outflows. Gains are broad-based across autos, banks, IT, and realty, led by Adani-linked stocks.

meta.note: Ambiguity remains over whether all prior U.S. levies were formally consolidated into the 18% rate.

text: Disney appoints Josh D'Amaro, head of Experiences, as CEO effective March 18, with Bob Iger remaining as senior advisor and board member until Dec. 31. Succession ends a prolonged internal contest centered on D'Amaro versus Dana Walden, while preserving the post-restructuring tri-divisional architecture (Entertainment, ESPN/Sports, Parks/Experiences).

meta.note: Overlap between personal leadership change and structural strategy made vector ranking nontrivial.

text: Walmart crosses a $1 trillion market capitalization as growth is led by e-commerce (+27% in Q3), its third-party marketplace, and advertising (+53%), which carry higher margins than stores. The company now sits in the Nasdaq-100 alongside major technology firms while traditional brick-and-mortar remains operational backbone. Leadership has just transitioned to John Furner, who previously ran U.S. operations.

meta.note: Blurred boundary between retail structure and platform structure made channel classification tight.
